text:
You need someone to finish the website end to end by fixing the front end and backend, resolving payment processing, adding a user reporting dashboard, and properly implementing GPT-3 into the chatbot experience.

I’m Noor Halden, and I’d be a strong fit for this because I’ve spent 6 years building machine learning and NLP solutions in Python, including work with PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, pandas, XGBoost, and general machine learning workflows. For chatbot and LLM work specifically, I focus on making systems reliable, maintainable, and easy to integrate into an existing product rather than treating them as standalone demos.

One relevant project was Delivery support chatbot for Parcelwise Logistics, where I built a WhatsApp and SMS assistant using Python, OpenAI API, LangGraph, FastAPI, Redis, and Twilio. It tracked parcels, rescheduled deliveries, and handed off to a human with the full context. That system resolved 43% of conversations without an agent and achieved a CSAT score of 4.4 out of 5. The work required careful NLP handling, smooth backend integration, and making sure the assistant fit into a real customer workflow.

For your site, I’d approach this by first reviewing the current front end, backend, and payment flow to identify what is incomplete or breaking. Then I’d wire the chatbot logic into the website cleanly, make sure the GPT-3 integration is stable, and ensure the user experience is consistent across the app. I’d also build or repair the reporting dashboard so users can see the information they need clearly.

I’m comfortable working independently, troubleshooting incomplete systems, and improving existing chatbot products rather than starting from scratch. If you want, I can help bring the current site to a finished, working state and make the chatbot experience feel polished and dependable.
